name: Colonel Kurzen
summary: In northern Stranglethorn Vale, Colonel Kurzen's former soldiers seek to end his rule. Once trusted by Stormwind, he now commands a rogue militia from an armed compound.

sections.title: A Fall from Grace
sections.body: Colonel Conrad Kurzen once served Stormwind as a capable and honorable officer. The kingdom's leaders trusted him with an expeditionary unit sent south into Stranglethorn Vale. Deep in the jungle, his behavior grew erratic and grandiose. He claimed the wilderness as his own and cast aside his loyalty to Stormwind.

sections.title: The Rebellion
sections.body: Kurzen's change divided his soldiers. Some followed him with blind loyalty or zeal, while others recoiled from his madness and brutality. When Emerine Junis rejected his advances, he threw her into the compound's prison. Lieutenant Doren led the soldiers who broke away and founded Rebel Camp along the northern road. Now they fight Kurzen's rampaging force to stop it.

sections.title: The Ogre Behind the Curtain
sections.body: Mai'Zoth, an ogre mage of the Mosh'ogg clan, used dark sorcery to possess Colonel Kurzen's mind. Jungle fever and exhaustion did not cause Kurzen's madness. Mai'Zoth turned a disciplined Stormwind detachment into violent pawns. Through the colonel, the ogre sought control of the region without open war.

faq.q: Why did Colonel Kurzen turn against Stormwind?
faq.answer: During his expedition into Stranglethorn Vale, Kurzen grew erratic and grandiose, then abandoned his loyalty to Stormwind. His former soldiers at Rebel Camp still seek the cause of his madness.
Colonel Kurzen commands his militia from Kurzen's Compound in the hills of northern Stranglethorn Vale. He lives in the fortified Stockpile building at the rear of the encampment.

faq.q: Who are the rebels at the Rebel Camp?
faq.answer: The rebels are former soldiers under Kurzen's command who refused to follow his madness. Lieutenant Doren leads them from Rebel Camp near the northern border. They fight to end Kurzen's rogue army and remain loyal to Stormwind.
Emerine Junis was attached to the expedition and rejected Kurzen's advances. As his cruelty and delusion grew, he locked her in the compound's prison cages.

faq.q: Is Kurzen acting alone in the jungle?
faq.answer: No. Kurzen commands the human mercenaries, soldiers, and jungle fighters who stayed loyal to him after the rebels left for Rebel Camp.

faq.q: What happens if Colonel Kurzen is slain?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren asks Alliance adventurers to take Kurzen's head as proof of his death. He wants them to break the militia's chain of command and restore the Stormwind Army's honor.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Kurzen's fall is a grave military scandal and a tragic loss of Stormwind troops. Alliance command and local loyalists have authorized his death.
As a human of Stormwind, you can remember Kurzen as a respected leader. His fall into tyranny shows the dangers of the jungle.
As a warrior, you can see how disciplined martial strength can be twisted when will and honor are lost.
